description: A Team of high school students eager to explore more than just school textbooks. Willing to bring new ideas and creativity.
summary:
Project Team Canada is an data-driven solution coded to bring awareness about the forgotten and abandoned space explorers, bringing in a fun and exciting experience while exploring the pages and reading through the legacies of those explorers.Rather than presenting space exploration as a collection of successful missions, we highlight the explorers that eventually lost communication, were left behind, or had their missions come to an end.
Our project addresses the challenge by making space exploration history more accessible, especially for younger audiences, through an educational yet enjoyable way of learning. We believe that losing contact with a space explorers should not mean losing its story. Every mission contributes to our understanding of the universe, and preserving these stories helps us recognize the science, innovation, and effort behind them.
details:
Our project, Abandoned, Not Forgotten, is an interactive, data-driven website developed to bring awareness to forgotten and abandoned space explorers. It allows visitors to explore the histories, discoveries, challenges, and legacies of these missions through an engaging combination of research, visuals, and interactive webpage elements.

The main benefit of our project is making space exploration history more accessible and interesting to a wider audience. We aim to encourage curiosity about space science while highlighting how even missions that were unsuccessful, abandoned, or lost communication have contributed to scientific knowledge.

We used coding and web development tools to create a platform that combines education with an enjoyable browsing experience. Our creative approach was to move beyond traditional research-based presentations and turn learning into an exploration of its own. Throughout development, we considered the accuracy of information, website navigation, visual appeal, accessibility, and how to present complex scientific information in a simple and engaging way.

Our intended impact is to remind people that although some space explorers may have been forgotten, their contributions and stories are still worth discovering.
